dict.string: PlatyNotch asks your terminal app to bring an agent's tab to the front, asks Spotify or Music what is playing, and, only when you click Add current tab, asks Safari, Chrome or Arc for the address of the front tab so you can pin it. Only while the Mail widget is on and Mail is open, it asks Mail for your unread count and the sender and subject of the newest unread messages.
PlatyNotch listens to what your Mac is playing, only while music plays, to move the bars. Nothing is recorded or kept.
PlatyNotch shows when your AirPods or other headphones connect, with their battery, after you turn this on in Settings. It never pairs or connects devices.
PlatyNotch shows your camera as a mirror only while you have it open.
PlatyNotch shows your meetings and their reminders in the notch, and adds events you type in quick add. Calendar data stays on your Mac.
PlatyNotch reads your notes vault for open tasks and adds your quick notes to today's daily note, only after you choose the vault in Settings. Ticking a task changes only its checkbox.

PlatyNotch shows downloads in progress and a notice when one finishes, after you turn this on in Settings. It reads file names only, never their contents, and does nothing to a file unless you click.
PlatyNotch shows reminders due today in the notch, ticks them off, and adds the ones you type in quick add. Reminders stay on your Mac.
